title: Core Documentation - 技术规格与项目同步

requirements: Create 1 file: docs/services/subsonic-api.md (Subsonic API 对接文档，~150-180 lines)
Create 1 file: docs/development-guide.md (开发环境搭建与构建说明，~100-120 lines)
Update 1 file: PROJECT_PLAN.md (同步实际实现状态，修正 ~15 处偏差)
Create 1 file: CHANGELOG.md (变更日志，记录 Phase 1 完成内容，~40-60 lines)
subsonic-api.md must cover 6 API categories: [系统, 浏览, 搜索, 媒体, 播放列表, 标记]
subsonic-api.md must document 15 API endpoints from SubsonicClient
PROJECT_PLAN.md updates: sync Phase 1 checklist, note go_router unused, note audio_handler incomplete
acceptance: docs/services/subsonic-api.md created: verify by test -f docs/services/subsonic-api.md && wc -l >= 100
subsonic-api.md covers 15 endpoints: verify by grep -c '###\|`' docs/services/subsonic-api.md >= 15
docs/development-guide.md created: verify by test -f docs/development-guide.md && wc -l >= 80
PROJECT_PLAN.md updated: verify by grep -c 'audio_handler.*incomplete\|go_router.*unused' PROJECT_PLAN.md >= 1
CHANGELOG.md created: verify by test -f CHANGELOG.md && grep -c 'Phase 1' CHANGELOG.md >= 1

project_divergences: go_router declared in pubspec.yaml but not used in app.dart (uses MaterialApp.home)
audio_handler.dart only 32 lines, incomplete (missing play/pause/skip methods)
drift/sqlite not in pubspec.yaml despite being in PROJECT_PLAN.md
palette_generator not in pubspec.yaml despite being in PROJECT_PLAN.md
